ItemID: unavailable; Title: wansview Security Camera Outdoor, 1080P Pan-Tilt 360° Surveillance Waterproof WiFi Camera, Night Vision, 2-Way Audio, Smart Siren, SD Card Storage&Cloud Storage, Works with Alexa W9-B (With RJ45 Port); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Alexa compatibility and outdoor monitoring appeal to me given my Echo devices and earlier home security purchase.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: FULLJA WiFi Digital Picture Frame - 10.1 Inch Smart Digital Photo Frame with FHD IPS Touch Screen, 32GB Memory, Motion Sensor WiFi Electronic Picture Frame Share Photos and Videos Via App Email; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently added an Echo Show and would explore its photo display before buying a separate frame.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Motorola MA1 Wireless Android Auto Car Adapter - Instant Connection from Smartphone to Car Screen with Easy Setup - Direct Plug-in USB Adapter - Secure Gel Pad Included; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need to confirm my phone and car support Android Auto before considering this adapter.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Made for Amazon Bluetooth Keyboard with detachable case in Black, for Fire HD 10 (11th Generation) 2021 release; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent keyboard purchase was for Mac or Windows, and I have no established need for a Fire HD 10 case.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: XPPen Artist12 Pro 11.6 Inch Drawing Monitor Pen Display Full-Laminated Graphics Drawing Tablet with Tilt Function Battery-Free Stylus and 8 Shortcut Keys(8192 Levels Pen Pressure and 72% NTSC); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A specialized drawing display does not fit my current focus on everyday computer accessories and Alexa devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Dash Cam for Cars 1080P FHD Car Dash Camera CHORTAU 2023 New Version Car Camera Recorder 3Inch Screen Dashboard Camera with 170° Wide Angle, Super Night Vision, WDR, Loop Recording, Parking Monitor; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My older GPS purchase alone does not give me a current reason to add another car device.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: WYZE Cam v3 with Color Night Vision, Wired 1080p HD Indoor/Outdoor Video Camera, 2-Way Audio, Works with Alexa, Google Assistant, and IFTTT; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this with my Echo setup for convenient home monitoring, especially with night vision and two-way audio.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Nitecore UMS4 Intelligent USB Four Slot Quick Battery Charger for Li-Ion/Ni-MH/Ni-Cd/IMR 16340 14500 18650 21700 20700 AA AAA and More Batteries, with LumenTac Battery Organizer; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My remote battery replacements and battery tester do not establish a need for this specialized charger right now.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: TriPole Small Desk Fan USB Powered Portable Fan 3 Speeds Strong Airflow Mini Fan 360°Rotation Personal Fan 5.1 Inch Table Fan for Home Office Bedroom Desktop, Black, 4.9ft Cable; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: USB power is convenient, but I am currently more interested in useful additions to my connected devices than a desk fan.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Silicon Power 512GB Micro SD Card U3 V30 SDXC Memory Card with Adapter for Nintendo-Switch, Steam Deck and Drone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Expandable storage interests me given my card reader and storage purchases; I would check capacity compatibility before choosing it for a camera.
